notes: Tag is Party & Casual's Childhood Game preset, so that is the mode, but the prompt asks for three separate maps — forest, desert, snow — and the answers say they rotate automatically each round, which is several distinct maps that cannot share one surface, so I swapped the preset's space-bounded for space-staged and the route is its P4 rather than the preset's P0. The override that would keep P4 off needs the prompt to say one continuous map; this says the opposite. Options: cover-los bent to each biome's props — trees, rock and cactus, drifts — for something to dodge around, social-hub as the space players wait in between rotations, teleporter-link as the lobby-to-map transport the rotation needs, trigger-scoring for the volume that registers a tag, and spawn-protected because strictly 1v1 means two even start points; obstacle-maze is dropped, nothing here is a warren. Deciding without a user: I read 1v1 as a two-player mode sharing the same three maps rather than a combat genre, since no fighting, weapons or arena is described, so no second genre is named and the maps stay bright and stylised as answered.
